Method of Attack: A common programming error leading to data overwritten and code execution in the context of affected iOS apps
Impacted Systems: iOS apps (15,978 out of 168,951 scanned apps), including high-profile apps such as Weibo, MOMO, NetEase Music, QQ Music, Kwai
Attack Vector: Network position to hijack or spoof traffic to the device
Indicators of Compromise: Demo video exploiting ZipperDown in the Weibo app to achieve code execution rights
Date of Discovery: Reported on Monday (exact date not specified)
